Algorithm 1. VECTORJOIN

Input: Query vectors X, data vectors Y, index retriever G, threshold θ, configuration cfg

Output: Join result set R

1: Load {G_X, G_Y} or G_X∪Y according to cfg.merged

2: O ← ORDERQUERIES(G, cfg)

3: Initialize query-level cache C, result set R ← ∅

4: foreach (q ∈ O) do

5:    S ← SEEDPHASE(q, C, G, cfg)

6:    (I, V) ← GREEDYSEARCHPHASE(q, S, Y, G, θ, cfg)

7:    hybrid ← CHECKHYBRID(q, G, cfg)

8:    I ← EXPANSIONPHASE(q, hybrid, I, V, Y, G, θ, cfg)

9:    R ← R ∪ I; UPDATECACHE(q, C, I, V, cfg)

10: return R

FieldMeaning
mergedWhether the index is merged or not.
work_sharingWork-sharing mode: none/hard/soft/self.
force_hybridAlways enable hybrid search.
adapt_hybridEnable hybrid search only when the query is predicted OOD.
greedy_beam_sizeMax queue size in greedy search (default: 256).
conv_thresholdThreshold for determining convergence in greedy search (default: 10, sensitivity analysis in Appendix D due to space limitation).
hybrid_beam_sizeMax queue size in hybrid search for out-range points (default: 256, sensitivity analysis in Figure 9).

Algorithm 2. ORDERQUERIES
Input: G, cfg
Output: Order of queries
1: if (cfg.work_sharing ∈ {hard, soft}) then
2: return the MST-based order from  \( G_{X} \)  or  \( G_{X\cup Y} \)  according to
cfg.merged
3: return an arbitrary order

Algorithm 3. SEEDPHASE
Input: Query q, cache C, G, cfg
Output: Seed set S
1:  \( S \leftarrow \{s_{X \cup Y}\} \)  if cfg.merged else  \( \{s_Y\} \)  /* from  \( G_{X \cup Y} \)  or  \( G_Y \)  */
2: switch (cfg.work_sharing) do
3:    case (hard or soft) do
4:    |  \( S \leftarrow S \cup C[q.parent] \)  /* hard/soft work sharing */
5:    case (self) do
6:    |  \( S \leftarrow S \cup \{q\} \)  /* merged index */
7: return S

Algorithm 4. GREEDYSEARCHPHASE
Input: Query q, seeds S, Y, G, θ, cfg
Output: Discovered in-range points I, visited points V
1:  \( I \leftarrow \{u | u \in S, dist(u, q) < \theta\} /* in-range data points discovered */ 
2:  \( V \leftarrow S /* visited points */ 
3: Initialize Q from S /* min-priority queue by dist(\cdot, q) */ 
4: while (Q ≠ ∅ and not STOPGREEDY(q, front(Q), Y, θ, cfg)) do 
5:    u ← popFront(Q)
6:    foreach (neighbor v of u with v∉V) do 
7:    V ← V ∪ {v}; δ ← dist(v, q); insert v into Q with key δ
8:    if (v ∈ Y and δ < θ) then 
9:    I ← I ∪ {v}
10:    trim Q to at most cfg.greedy_beam_size smallest keys
11: return (I, V)

Algorithm 5. STOPGREEDY
Input: Query q, front element (d, u) of greedy queue Q, Y, θ, cfg
Output: Whether to stop greedy walk
1: if (d < θ) and (u ∈ Y) then return true
2: if d has not been decreased for cfg.conv_threshold iterations in GREEDYSEARCHPHASE then return true
3: if cfg.merged and u ≠ q then return true
4: return false

Algorithm 6. CHECKHYBRID
Input: q, G, cfg
Output: Whether to use hybrid search
1: if (cfg.merged and cfg.adapt_hybrid) then
2:    return (whether query q is predicted OOD)
3: else
4:    return cfg.force_hybrid

Algorithm 7. EXPANSIONPHASE
Input: Query q, hybrid search enabled hybrid, initial in-range points I, visited V, Y, G, θ, cfg
Output: Final in-range points I
1: Initialize Q from I /* min-priority queue by dist(·,q) if cfg.merged, otherwise FIFO */
2: while (Q ≠ Φ) do
3:    u ← popFront(Q)
4:    foreach (neighbor v of u with v∉V) do
5:    if (cfg.merged and v∉Y) then
6:    continue
7:    V ← V ∪ {v}; δ ← dist(v,q)
8:    if (δ < θ) then
9:    insert v into Q; I ← I ∪ {v}
10:    else
11:    if (hybrid) then
12:    insert v into Q; trim Q to at most
    max(cfg.hybrid_beam_size, |Q| - 1) keys
    /* don't discard in-range points */
13: return I

Algorithm 8. UPDATECACHE
Input: Query q, cache C, in-range points I, visited V, cfg
1: switch (cfg.work_sharing) do
2:    case (hard) do
3:    | C[q] ← I
4:    case (soft) do
5:    | C[q] ← top-1 closest data point in V to q
